user.title: Tauron Power Outages
user.description: Find your city, town or village in Tauron's register of addresses.

data_description.city: At least 3 letters of its name, with Polish letters (e.g. "Wrocław").

pick_city.title: Choose your city
pick_city.description: Several places match. Each is shown with its commune (gm.), district (pow.) and province.

street.title: Find your street
street.description: Searching streets in {city}. In a village without named streets, keep its name and press Submit.

data_description.street: At least 3 letters from any part of the street's name.

data_description.house_no: Your house number, as on Tauron's website.
data_description.name: Names the device and starts its entity IDs (e.g. calendar.ogrodnica_outages).
data_description.locality: Only outages whose message names this place (e.g. "Ogrodnica") are shown, case-insensitive. Leave empty to include every outage in the feed.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Tauron API
error.no_matches: No matches for "{query}". Use Polish letters, e.g. "Wrocław", not "Wroclaw".
error.too_many: More than 20 matches for "{query}". Type more of the name.
error.house_number: "{query}" looks like a house number — you'll enter it in the last step. Here, type the street's name; in a village without street names, leave "{city_name}" and click Submit.

init.title: Tauron Power Outages Options
init.description:
Watching: {address}

Change the Locality and update interval without re-adding the integration.

data_description.locality: Only outages whose message names this place (e.g. "Ogrodnica") are shown, case-insensitive. Leave empty to include every outage in the feed.
data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to poll the Tauron API. Minimum 1, default 4 hours.
